'''Daelfruit''' was a type of [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] that [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Saes Rrogon]] enjoyed during his childhood on [[Kalee/Legends|Kalee]]. It had a rough, [[brown]] rind that had to be peeled back in order to reach the fruit's pale, sweet flesh.
